questions.stem: A box contains 16 red and blue balls. If one red ball is removed and one blue ball is added, the number of red balls becomes equal to the number of blue balls. The original number of red balls is:
solutionSketch: x + y = 16 and x − 1 = y + 1, so x − y = 2.
Hence x = 9 and y = 7. After the change: 8 and 8.

questions.stem: A box contains 18 red and black balls. If 2 red balls are removed and 2 black balls are added, the number of red balls becomes equal to the number of black balls. The original number of red balls is:
solutionSketch: x + y = 18 and x − 2 = y + 2, so x − y = 4. Hence x = 11 and y = 7.
Trap: answering 9 (the common number after the change).

questions.stem: 40 students go on a trip: some pay 15 000 LL and the others pay 9 000 LL. The total is 516 000 LL. The number of students who pay 9 000 LL is:
solutionSketch: y = 40 − x: 5x + 120 − 3x = 172, so 2x = 52, x = 26 (full price) and y = 14.
Trap: answering the 26 who pay the full price.
